answer: Proof of Useful Work serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to expend computational nectar to solve verifiable tasks. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities across the network horizon faces linear costs proportional to the computational dune they must mine. By binding identity creation to finite, non-reusable resource expenditure, the system forces an economic trade-off that makes mass Sybil deployment prohibitively expensive for malicious actors.
